expected_behavior: Catch NotFoundError, halt camera stream, display error alert, transition to Error state
actual_behavior: Catches NotFoundError in startDetectorWithSource, displays 'Requested device not found', sets status='error'
recovery_behavior: UI displays error banner and Retry button; allows user to select Video File or Screen Share mode

expected_behavior: Catch NotAllowedError, display permission request toast, prevent app crash
actual_behavior: Catches NotAllowedError, displays 'Permission denied' toast, halts stream gracefully
recovery_behavior: User can enable camera permissions in browser settings and click Retry without reloading page

expected_behavior: Set faceDetected=false, clear overlays, reset trust score to 0 (NO_FACE), keep loop active
actual_behavior: HUD shows 'No Face Detected', trust score resets to 0, diagnostic buffers reset, pipeline continues listening
recovery_behavior: Automatically resumes full tracking the moment a face re-enters the viewport

expected_behavior: Immediately transition faceDetected to false, clear EMA buffers, reset alert timers
actual_behavior: Detection loop detects landmark loss, resets rPPG and anatomy buffers, drops score to 0, cancels pending alerts
recovery_behavior: When subject turns back, MediaPipe re-acquires landmarks and EMA buffers re-initialize cleanly

expected_behavior: Reduced rPPG chrominance SNR, rppgConfidence drops < 0.25, Non-Linear Veto engages
actual_behavior: rPPG confidence drops to ~0.15, Non-Linear Veto rule clamps trust score to <= 33 (DEEPFAKE), alert HUD notifies low confidence
recovery_behavior: Non-linear veto prevents false positive authentication under poor lighting; score recovers when illumination improves

expected_behavior: Return bpm=null, confidence=0.0 during initial 30-frame buffer warm-up, UI displays 'Locking in...'
actual_behavior: HUD displays 'Locking in...', scoreBiological=0.0, non-linear veto prevents premature trust score inflation
recovery_behavior: Automatically calculates valid heart rate and confidence once 30 frames (~1 sec) accumulate

expected_behavior: rppgConfidence < 0.25 triggers Non-Linear Veto rule, overriding high visual score
actual_behavior: Overrides high visual CNN score, caps trust score at 33/100, sets decision to DEEPFAKE/UNCERTAIN
recovery_behavior: Score unlocks automatically when subject remains still and coherent pulse signal is restored

expected_behavior: Catch user cancellation on getDisplayMedia picker, display toast, return to idle state
actual_behavior: Catches cancellation error, displays 'Screen share cancelled' toast, resets status to 'idle'
recovery_behavior: Application remains fully responsive; user can re-trigger screen share or switch back to webcam

expected_behavior: Catch GPU delegate initialization failure, log warning, fallback to CPU delegate
actual_behavior: Catches GPU delegate error in face-detector.ts and cnn-analyzer.ts, falls back to CPU delegate/backend
observed_error: GPU delegate unavailable, falling back to CPU
recovery_behavior: Pipeline runs continuously on CPU with slightly higher latency (~150ms per frame)

expected_behavior: Catch WASM fetch failure, log error, display user-friendly error message, halt pipeline
actual_behavior: Catches fetch rejection in startDetectorWithSource, displays 'Failed to load vision tasks WASM binaries', sets status='error'
observed_error: RuntimeError: Failed to fetch WASM binary at /wasm/
recovery_behavior: UI shows diagnostic error message advising check of local static assets directory

expected_behavior: Temporal sampling aliasing (Nyquist limit violated < 5 FPS), rPPG confidence drops < 0.20, FPS HUD updates
actual_behavior: rPPG confidence drops, Non-linear veto clamps trust score, FPS HUD displays < 5 FPS, pipeline remains stable without timing crash
recovery_behavior: Pipeline performance recovers as system load decreases and frame rate returns above 15 FPS

expected_behavior: Support per-subject face detection, tracking separation, and multi-face trust scoring
actual_behavior: FaceLandmarker configured for numFaces:1; Detect.tsx accesses faceLandmarks[0] only; secondary faces are ignored
observed_error: N/A - Feature Not Implemented (Single face architecture)
recovery_behavior: System tracks only the first primary face detected in faceLandmarks[0] and ignores extra subjects
